This work product serves the following purposes:

  • To communicate testing scope, risks and other parameters that impact the test effort to stakeholders at the beginning of the project.
  • To act as the foundation for stakeholders to plan for test activities required to successfully test the target solution and to effectively control the test effort.

The amount of information contained in this artifact varies from one project to the next based on factors such as duration, complexity and size of the test effort. Topics typically covered in this artifact include:

  • Scope of testing
    • Overall objectives of the testing effort and the approach to quality
    • Key target solution risks and how they will be addressed by testing
    • Assumptions, constraints, dependencies and other project constraints
    • What levels of testing are included
    • What types of testing are needed
  • Required testing resources and high-level estimate of the test effort
  • Required test environments
  • Test management tools
  • Test data strategy
  • Test metrics and key performance indicators to measure efficiency, effectiveness and progress of the test effort and resulting quality of the solution
